metricDefinitions.unplayedDrawn: Drawn-minus-played instance proxy; not proof that a card was never legally playable. Includes cards deliberately held by AI.
metricDefinitions.evolution: Final instance locations proxy; the AI and completed-board opportunities can limit evolutions independently of deck dependency support.
metricDefinitions.firstPlacementAt: Recorded action index of each player's first placement, including mulligan actions; not elapsed time or turn number.
metricDefinitions.opening: An actual legal rank/territory check before and after the engine AI mulligan, separately for both player positions.
